sections.Aims and Fit of Module: To provide students with theoretical knowledge and lab-based training in pharmaceutical analysis and analytical instrumentation involved.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Demonstrate a critical awareness and understanding of the latest development of analytical techniques and existing forms of drug specimen B Evaluate the principles of the methodologies and apply them to analyze various drug specimen C Critically evaluate the data obtained from the instruments and interpret them properly D Understand, consider and apply research ethics and health and safety regulations to prioritize, arrange and organize lab work
sections.Method of teaching and learning: Course content will be delivered by standard lectures and laboratory practice. Timely, relevant and specific, constructive and actionable feedback will be provided to students in-class, on-paper and/or in-person on for each assignment.
